components.css: .ds-thread { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 32px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Public Sans', sans-serif); color: var(--foreground, #13231c); } .ds-thread li { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr; gap: 16px; } .ds-thread li:not(:last-child)::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 40px; bottom: -32px; left: 20px; width: 1px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal, #12897f) 50%, transparent); } .ds-ring { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal, #12897f) 40%, transparent); background: var(--card, #ffffff); color: var(--teal, #12897f); } .ds-thread h3 { margin: 6px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-heading, 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-thread p { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--muted-foreground, #4f5f57); } .ds-ledger { margin: 20px 0 0; max-width: 24rem; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e3e1d8); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card, #ffffff); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -16px rgb(11 21 18 / 0.35); } .ds-ledger figcaption { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, #4f5f57); } .ds-ledger dl { margin: 12px 0 0; } .ds-ledger dl > div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-ledger dl > div + div { border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal, #12897f) 25%, transparent); } .ds-ledger dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 500; color: var(--primary, #0f7a4f); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ledger small { font-size: 0.75rem; }

narrative.overview:
PactVault reads like a well-kept ledger on warm paper: a calm, trustworthy fintech surface where every figure is legible and every page asks for one thing. The ground is a warm off-white (dark: a deep green-black), content sits on plain white cards with hairline edges, and the ink is a deep green-black rather than pure black. Colour is spent sparingly and by role, never for decoration: green means "do this" or "this is money", blue means "this is a link or an identity", teal draws the quiet structure (icons, dividers, the thread between stages, the focus ring).

Density is low. Pages are a single column of intent: a large Space Grotesk statement, one plain sentence, one green action, and the real mechanism beside it. The signature device is the pact thread: stages joined by a hairline teal line through outlined teal icon rings, ending on a money state. The system refuses the crypto default of dark neon, gradient text and hero metrics; nothing here implies real money, and devnet is always labelled.

Light and dark are equal citizens. The theme follows the system setting by default with a manual Light / Dark / System toggle (class strategy), and every role has a tuned dark counterpart rather than an inversion.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white ground, white cards, deep green ink; dark mode is green-black, not grey.
Three colour roles with hard boundaries: green for action and money, blue for links and identity, teal for non-text structure.
Money in tabular numerals, in green, with the unit set smaller beside it.
Hairline borders and teal-tinted dividers over heavy shadows.
Space Grotesk headings with tight tracking; Public Sans for everything read; Geist Mono only for addresses.

rules.name: The Three Roles Rule
rules.body: Green is action and money. Blue is links, info and identity. Teal is structure that is never read. A colour used outside its role is a bug, with one exception: the green "Vault" in the wordmark.

rules.name: The One Green Action Rule
rules.body: Each page has exactly one filled green button. Secondary choices are ghost, outline or quiet text controls.

rules.name: The Dark Text On Green Rule
rules.body: In dark mode, green buttons carry dark text (on-green-dark), never white.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every amount uses tabular numerals and two decimals for USDC; the unit sits after the figure at a smaller size.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Addresses Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears only on wallet, mint and transaction identifiers, shortened as `abcd…wxyz`.

rules.name: The Border First Rule
rules.body: Every raised surface has a hairline border; the shadow is optional and never replaces the border.

dos: **Do** keep exactly one filled green button per page; it is the page's main action.
**Do** set every amount in green tabular numerals with the unit smaller beside it.
**Do** use blue for every link, the Devnet badge and wallet identity badges.
**Do** keep teal to icons, rings, dividers, the pact thread and the focus ring.
**Do** use dark text (#0B1512) on green buttons in dark mode.
**Do** give raised surfaces a hairline border before any shadow, and tint shadows green-black.
**Do** follow the system theme by default and keep the Light / Dark / System toggle in the header.
**Do** use the owner-supplied mark files as they are, light and dark variants.
donts: **Don't** set text in teal; it is below AA at small sizes.
**Don't** use green for decoration, headings or non-money emphasis (the "Vault" wordmark is the only exception).
**Don't** use dark neon, gradient text or hero metrics.
**Don't** put white text on the dark-mode green.
**Don't** use Geist Mono for anything except addresses and identifiers.
**Don't** redraw or recolour the brand mark.
